facts.fact: Gemnation reports that cash transfer beneficiaries are paid through EcoCash, and that urban residents were told to register on NetOne One Wallet lines.

Gemnation reports that the Harmonised Social Cash Transfer programme pays beneficiaries by electronic transfer (EcoCash), citing the Auditor-General's note that the payment method has changed from cash.
